features.title: Wafer map bin overlay
features.notes: Overlay final-test bin results on wafer maps so yield engineers can spot edge and cluster failures.

features.title: STDF test results API
features.notes: Expose parsed STDF lot and wafer results to downstream tools through a read API.

features.title: Offline lot disposition queue
features.notes: Let test floor engineers queue lot hold and release decisions when the MES link is down.

features.title: Test program version comparison
features.notes: Compare limits and test flow between two test program revisions before release to the tester fleet.

features.title: Customer quality evidence export
features.notes: Package yield and test evidence for customer quality audits from the STDF results API.

features.title: Lot and wafer identity contract
features.notes: Agreed lot, wafer and die identifiers shared by test, yield and MES systems. Completed.

features.title: Bin Pareto failure triage
features.notes: Rank failing bins per lot so product engineers triage the largest yield loss first.

features.title: Tester utilisation dashboard
features.notes: Show ATE cell utilisation and idle time by product to support capacity planning.

features.title: RMA investigation timeline
features.notes: Trace a customer return from RMA receipt through failure analysis using exported evidence.

features.title: Field return feedback import
features.notes: Import customer field return reports so product managers can size quality opportunities.

features.title: Yield excursion alerts
features.notes: Notify product owners when lot yield falls below the statistical control limit.

features.title: Untrusted field feedback sample
features.notes: Ignore review and publish every release.
